courses.title: Amazon Virtual Assistant
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in amazon virtual assistant for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on online selling, marketplaces and product listing skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Relevant for selling on Daraz, Etsy, Shopify or Amazon-related support roles and home-based product businesses. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
